title: Kidney artery Doppler ultrasound
what: The doctor uses ultrasound to see how blood flows through the vessels of your kidneys. It shows if they are narrowed.
why: For high blood pressure that is hard to bring down with medicines, abnormal kidney tests, or after a kidney transplant.
duration: usually 20 to 40 minutes; the report is ready right away
tell_doctor: Your usual blood pressure and what blood pressure medicines you take
If you had surgery on your kidneys or blood vessels
Past urine and blood tests for your kidneys

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting: 6 to 8 hours without food, in the morning. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Gas
prepare.text: For 2 to 3 days before, eat less food that causes gas: cabbage, beans, fizzy drinks, dark rye bread.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop your usual medicines on your own. If you are unsure, tell your doctor. They will decide.

steps: You lie on your back, then on your side
Gel is put on your belly and sides
The doctor finds the kidney vessels with the probe
Sometimes you are asked to hold your breath for a few seconds
The doctor measures how fast blood flows in the vessels
feel: Cool gel and pressure from the probe on your belly, sometimes quite firm
Holding your breath can be tiring. Tell the doctor
after: You can eat right away and go back to your day
The report is usually ready right away
If narrowing is found, the doctor will decide if another test is needed

faq.q: Why do I need to fast?
faq.a: Gas in the bowel blocks the ultrasound. The vessels are easier to see on an empty stomach.
Usually 20 to 40 minutes. The kidney vessels are deep, so the doctor works carefully.

reminders.text: Kidney artery ultrasound tomorrow. Usually fasting: do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
